events.summary: 女仆凯德给塔拉辛盘发，把金簪硬插进乱发堆里，扎破了她的头皮。
events.quote: Khaede pushed a tiny golden pin into the sloppy mass of limp curls that she’d piled high atop Talasyn’s head. The latter jerked as the sharp point pricked her skull.

events.summary: 塔拉辛穿红金两色礼服走进议事厅，阿拉里克一见她就担心今天办不成正事。
events.quote: His wife swept into his council room and Alaric was immediately gripped by the fear that he would get absolutely nothing done today.

events.summary: 利苏准将当众质疑塔拉辛出席议事厅是否明智，搬出多明尼恩境内的刺杀和夜皇后的萨尔达维亚旧关系。
events.quote: not to mention the Night Empress’s former ties to the Sardovian Allfold—I have my doubts as to whether her presence at a council where we discuss matters of state and security is advisable.”

events.summary: 阿拉里克回击利苏，并宣布由“阿伦西娜女皇”决定哪些提案可以上呈扎希亚-拉奇斯。
events.quote: “Empress Alunsina will decide,” Alaric said, taking far more delight than he ought to in every carefully enunciated syllable

events.summary: 塔拉辛逐条质询诸将提案，收尾时宣布将择优上呈天穹宫。
events.quote: “Thank you for your cooperation. I shall take some time to review your offers, the best of which will be forwarded to the Roof of Heaven posthaste.

events.summary: 达里乌斯准将提议开发海岸圣地马哈吉尔安息岛，塔拉辛当场打断，点明该岛是海岸之民的圣地、此举行同亵渎。
events.quote: “Wait,” Talasyn interrupted Darius. “The Night Empire plans to develop Mahagir’s Rest? That island is sacred to the people of the Coast.”

events.summary: 议事厅讨论把刑事责任年龄降到十三岁，塔拉辛双拳砸桌，喊出“人不是东西”。
events.quote: “Utility?” In her ire, Talasyn wasn’t even fully conscious of both her fists slamming down on the surface of the table, the ebony wood thudding against her flesh. “People are not things!”

events.summary: 阿拉里克当众训斥塔拉辛，说他的议事厅容不下道德义愤，他的裁决只问帝国利益、不问情感。
events.quote: “There is no room for moral indignation at my council,” Alaric brusquely informed her through gritted teeth.

relations.b: 阿拉里克（Alaric／夜之帝国皇帝）
relations.quote: She wouldn’t be able to bear the pain. That certainty pierced her as she sat beside her husband, his hand covering hers and feeling far too much like home.

relations.relation: 主仆兼同盟（凯德谋得贴身女仆之位以随行）
relations.quote: “The goal was to be assigned your lady’s maid. I would have said anything.”

relations.relation: 护卫／护送者（奉命引她入议事厅）
relations.quote: A knock on the door indicated that Sevraim had arrived to escort her to the council meeting.

relations.relation: 政敌（曾以凯德的情报换取铁甲舰指挥权）
relations.quote: He was the officer who had sailed to Iantas with information on Khaede, which he’d exchanged for command of a Voidfell-powered ironclad.

relations.relation: 旧日同伙／随时可能照面的隐患
relations.quote: Khaede had assured Talasyn that she was confident hers and Darius’s paths would never cross, but it was still an enormous risk.

numbers.context: 整场提案陈述持续的时间
numbers.quote: Over the hour and a half that ensued, Talasyn listened to one proposal after another, grateful for the distraction they provided.

numbers.context: 拟将刑事责任年龄下调至十三岁
numbers.quote: Her teeth bared when the council opened the floor to the issue of lowering the age of criminal liability to thirteen.

numbers.context: 现行法律下十八岁以下不得监禁
numbers.quote: local syndicates frequently take advantage of the fact that those below the age of eighteen cannot be imprisoned under our current laws

numbers.context: 一年前诸将还下令见到塔拉辛就地格杀
numbers.quote: given that they’d been ordering their men to kill her on sight a year ago

numbers.context: 数月前那场刺杀中她杀了一名萨尔达维亚叛军救下阿拉里克
numbers.quote: and of the one months before, where she killed a Sardovian rebel to save my life

numbers.context: 马哈吉尔安息岛数百年无人踏足
numbers.quote: “No one’s set foot there in centuries,” Talasyn snapped. Alaric tightened his grip on her knee as though in warning, but she ignored him.
